definitions: To have a grievance or complaint to discuss with someone.
To have an issue to resolve with someone, often implying a disagreement or argument.
examples: I had a bone to pick with him about the missed deadline.
She had a bone to pick with the manager regarding her pay.
They had a bone to pick with the council over the new parking rules.
lemma: have a bone to pick with
source: had a bone to pick with
